verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Parahelp clustering conversations by topic or detecting emerging product issues before ticket volume rises. The closest features are automations that watch the support queue and 'surface gaps', and on-demand reports on where the Customer Agent falls short. Both target the AI agent's own configuration and performance gaps, not topic clustering or product-issue trend detection, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, the platform clusters conversations by topic and surfaces emerging product issues before they spike ticket volume
